test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The team decided to **__pull out all the stops__** for their upcoming presentation.

options.text: Wait patiently for a more favourable time
Give up easily and without thinking much
To do everything to make something successful

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"pull out all the stops"** means to do everything you can to make something successful. (हर संभव प्रयास करना) • **Example: **The team decided to pull out all the stops for their upcoming presentation. • **Option 4** implies doing everything possible to ensure success. (हर संभव प्रयास करना) • **Example: **The organizers pulled out all the stops to make the event memorable. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Keep things simple and straightforward** (साधारण और सीधा रखना): To not complicate things. • **Example:** For the initial phase, we decided to keep things simple and straightforward. • **Option 2: Wait patiently for a more favourable time** (एक और अनुकूल समय के लिए धैर्यपूर्वक प्रतीक्षा करना): To delay action until a better opportunity arises. • **Example: **They decided to wait patiently for a more favourable time before making their move. • **Option 3: Give up easily and without thinking much** (आसानी से हार मान लेना और ज्यादा नहीं सोचना): To stop trying without putting in much effort. • **Example:** It's unlike him to give up easily and without thinking much. cc:Taad, The correct answer is **Option 1.**
